        Local setup checklist
        1. Start LM Studio’s local server with any instruction-capable text model loaded.
        2. Run audiocpp_server with a Yue2 model entry. The downloadable package configures this for you.
        3. Keep this page open while a song generates; Yue2 can take several minutes on some hardware.
